# Copilot instructions

See **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** — the instructions for AI agents in this
repository live there, so every tool reads the same file and none of them drift.

The two lines worth repeating:

1. Run `pnpm verify` before suggesting a change is complete. It is the
   specification.
2. If a check fails, fix the code. Never weaken, disable, or delete a rule to
   make a change pass.
